title: In-season week (fallback template)
author: Grok Bot
notes: In-season: rugby Thu 7–8:30pm, match Sat 2pm. Leave 1–2 reps in the tank on every lift; no grinders after Wednesday. targetKg is blank until we know your working weights – log what you lift and the plan will be updated from your logs.

days.title: Lower strength
days.notes: Warm up 10 min (bike or skipping + hip mobility). If legs are still smashed from Saturday, drop one set from each lift.

days.title: Easy run or ride
days.notes: Option A: 25–30 min easy run (conversational pace) + 6 × 15s strides. Option B: 45–60 min easy ride. Keep it easy – this is recovery plus engine building.

days.title: Upper strength
days.notes: Keep it crisp – Thursday is training.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.notes: Leave kg blank for bodyweight; add load if 8 is easy

days.title: Rugby training
days.notes: Log feel, RPE and any scrum/contact notes.

days.title: Rest / mobility
days.notes: Hips, ankles, thoracic spine, neck. Hydrate and eat well before the match.

days.title: Match
days.notes: Log minutes played, scrum count/feel and any knocks.

days.title: Recovery ride or walk
days.notes: Easy spin or walk, then 10 min stretching. Note any niggles from the match.
